#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    
    bool insideBrackets = false;
    int countNoInside = 0, countMax = 0, wordSize = 0;
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        
        if (c != '(' && c != ')' && c != '_')
            wordSize++;
        if (c == '(') {
            countMax = max(countMax, wordSize);
            wordSize = 0;
            insideBrackets = true;
        }
        if (c == ')') {
            insideBrackets = false;
            if (wordSize > 0) {
                countNoInside++;
                wordSize = 0;
            }
        }
        if (c == '_') {
            if (insideBrackets && wordSize > 0)
                countNoInside++;
            else if (c == '_' && !insideBrackets)
                countMax = max(countMax, wordSize);
            wordSize = 0;
        }
    }
    countMax = max(countMax, wordSize);
    cout << countMax << " " << countNoInside << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
